headline: Proposed ordinance creating an Assistant Director of Personnel position, and several appointments to city boards and commissions.
summary: The agenda lists appointments to the Lawrence Cultural Council, Zoning Board of Appeals, and Airport Commission. It also includes proposed ordinances for an Assistant Director of Personnel and a Manager of Financial and Administrative Services, plus a new Executive Assistant position for the Police Department.
items: Appointment of Elvis A. Lora to the Lawrence Cultural Council (new business, October 20, 2026)
Creation of Ordinance for Assistant Director of Personnel [Ord No. 02.48.050] (tabled from October 6, 2026)
Appoint Miguel B. Aguilo to the Zoning Board of Appeals (tabled from June 2, 2026)
Creation of Executive Assistant Position, Police Department (tabled from February 17, 2026)
Confirm appointment of Kervin Valdez to the Airport Commission (tabled from February 3, 2026)
Confirm appointment of Sheila Cabrera to the Zoning Board of Appeals (tabled from October 1, 2024)
Proposed new ordinance for "Manager of Financial and Administrative Services" (02.64.060) (tabled from September 17, 2024)
Report on Board and Commissions by Councilor Jeovanny Rodriguez (tabled from February 18, 2020)
location: City Council Chambers, 200 Common Street, Lawrence, MA
